scope: Resolve Yarn Berry PnP module resolution failure in CI workflow and ensure 100% test passing across npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun

tasks.title: Configure Yarn Node-Modules Linker in CI/CD Verification Suite
tasks.description: Fix the MODULE_NOT_FOUND error during Yarn verification in .github/workflows/publish.yml. Because modern Yarn (v4 Corepack) defaults to Plug'n'Play (PnP) linking without a node_modules folder, raw node -e calls fail. Update the temporary Yarn test step to set 'yarn config set nodeLinker node-modules' prior to adding the tarball, or execute tests using 'yarn node -e'.

tasks.title: Local Tarball & Multi-Package-Manager Verification
tasks.description: Simulate the exact CI runner isolation steps locally: pack the tarball via 'npm pack', create isolated temporary test directories for npm, pnpm, yarn (v4), and bun, and verify that 'const { PPTXTemplater } = require("node-pptx-templater")' and ESM imports resolve cleanly across all four package managers.

tasks.title: Synchronize Pipeline Docs & Workspace Memory
tasks.description: Update .agent/project_summary.md and CI/CD workflow documentation to record the Yarn modern node-modules linker requirement during automated release testing.
